column1: # Models downloaded by the ComfyUI feature (features/comfyui.sh), one per line:
# The set is what COMFYUI_MODEL_SETS selects; the target
# directory is relative to ComfyUI's models/ folder; the
# SHA-256 is the one Hugging Face publishes for the file
#         GGUF + its Qwen2.5-VL text encoder, VAE and the
#         editing that keeps characters consistent; used by
#         comic-skills (INPAINT=qwen) to erase text over art.
#         Qwen3-4B text encoder and VAE. ~12 GB. Three times
#         faster than qwen, lower quality on detailed art.
